Figure2: Overview of HuggingGPT. With an LLM (e.g., ChatGPT) as the core controller and the expert models as the executors, the workflow of HuggingGPT consists of four stages: 1) Task planning: LLM parses the user request into a task list and determines the execution order and resource dependencies among tasks; 2) Model selection: LLM assigns appropriate models to tasks based on the description of expert models on Hugging Face; 3) Task execution: Expert models on hybrid endpoints execute the assigned tasks; 4) Response generation: LLM integrates the inference results of experts and generates a summary of workflow logs to respond to the user.
Figure 3: Evaluation of task planning with different numbers of demonstrations.
